articles.title: Starting Something New
articles.excerpt: Every blog starts the same way: an empty folder and a stubborn feeling that something is worth writing down. This one is no different, except that the site itself is going to keep changing shape around whatever I end up writing.

articles.title: Why I Keep Rebuilding This Blog
articles.excerpt:
I kept rebuilding the same static blog template for years before I asked a more interesting question: what if the site itself reacted to what people actually read, instead of looking identical to every visitor, forever?

That's the whole premise here. Open a few technology posts and the page leans cooler and bluer. Wander into the travel category and it drifts toward amber. Nothing dramatic — just enough that the site feels inhabited rather than static.
